item.title: Books on Mindanao culture, peace, identity win National Book Awards
item.description: DAVAO CITY, Philippines – Three Mindanao-themed books were among the winners of the 43rd National Book Awards. The awards, organized by the National Book Development Board (NBB) and the Filipino Critics Circle (FCC), announced 30 winners from 139 finalists in different categories and languages. item.title: Seven dead in landslides in Mati and Monkayo
item.description: DAVAO CITY, Philippines – Seven people, consisting of a family in Mati, Davao Oriental and another in Monkayo, Davao de Oro, died after their houses collapsed from separate landslides brought by heavy rain across Davao Region for days.
